title: LCA Lead | Life Cycle Analysis Lead
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.
People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

Key Responsibilities

LCA Development & Execution

  • Conduct full Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for mining, rock sourcing, transportation, and field spreading processes .
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards , GHG Protocols, IPCC guidelines, and relevant carbon accounting frameworks .
  • Quantify the carbon footprint and co-benefits of InPlanet’s Enhanced Rock Weathering projects for emissions avoidance and reductions linked to changes in agronomic practices.

Scalability & Process Optimization

  • Develop scalable LCA methodologies to streamline assessment processes across multiple projects.
  • Integrate automation tools where possible to reduce manual data collection bottlenecks .
  • Identify opportunities for emissions reduction in our supply chain and propose actionable sustainability strategies.

Carbon Reporting & Certification

  • Produce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) statements and carbon accounting reports to support MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) requirements .
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align LCA outputs with carbon credit certification needs .

Stakeholder & Data Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with mines and supply chain partners to facilitate accurate and timely data collection.
  • Coordinate with farmers and supply chain teams to ensure high-quality input data .
  • Troubleshoot data gaps when mines or other partners do not provide necessary information (e.g. secondary mine process data).

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that LCA insights inform strategic decision-making at InPlanet.
  • Present findings to internal teams and external partners, communicating complex sustainability assessments in a clear and actionable manner .

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience with LCA methodologies and tools (e.g., SimaPro, OpenLCA, GaBi , or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 LCA standards and/or GHG accounting protocols .
  • 7+ years of experience in carbon accounting and sustainability impact assessments .
  • Knowledge of mining, agriculture, or supply chain sustainability is a strong plus.
  • Ability to structure LCAs for scalability in a fast-growing company.
Key Qualities
  • High attention to detail —accuracy in sustainability reporting is critical.
  • Solution-oriented mindset —doesn’t just point out gaps, but proposes fixes and optimisations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Driven and resilient —pushes forward despite data collection challenges.
  • Comfortable with uncertainty —navigates the evolving landscape of carbon markets with adaptability.
Bonus Points (but not essential)
  • Certified LCA Practitioner (ACLCA)
  • Greenhouse Gas Accounting Certification (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
  • Certified Carbon Auditor
  • ISO 14040/14044 LCA Training

Benefits

  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. Competitive.
  • Share options (ESOP) to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference, and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Location: Brazil (Preferably near São Paulo)
Languages: Fluent in Portuguese & English

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.
This is a high-impact role at the core of our mission. If you're passionate about climate solutions and have a track record of data-driven sustainability analysis, we’d love to have you on board.

The Impact You Can Make

  • Develop and execute high-quality LCAs to quantify the environmental footprint of our supply chain, from rock mining to field application.
  • Establish scalable methodologies and refine LCA frameworks that can be applied efficiently across multiple geographies and project types.
  • Enable InPlanet to meet the strictest carbon market standards , ensuring credibility in the issuance of high-quality carbon removal credits.
  • Strengthen our network by building trust with mining and farming stakeholders , optimising data collection, and improving transparency.
  • Support the integration of LCA insights into business decisions , helping to shape strategic choices around material sourcing, transportation, and field deployment.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

description:
Descrição de Cargo: Analista de Suporte Nível 2 (N2)

Horário de Trabalho: 15h às 23h
Experiência Mínima: 2 anos na área de suporte em redes e segurança, com atuação em ambientes NOC (Network Operations Center).
Local: (Inserir localização ou informar se é remoto).

Responsabilidades Principais:

  1. Análise de Capacity e Performance:

    • Realizar análises de capacidade e desempenho de equipamentos de redes, identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias.

  2. Atendimento de Chamados:

    • Atender chamados de nível avançado relacionados a redes e segurança, garantindo resolução eficaz e dentro dos SLAs estabelecidos.

  3. Gestão de Equipamentos:

    • Gerenciar o parque de equipamentos dos clientes e da empresa, assegurando o cumprimento do ciclo de vida, atualizações e melhores práticas.

  4. Desenho e Implementação:

    • Desenhar, implementar, configurar e gerenciar firewalls de múltiplos fabricantes utilizando técnicas avançadas de roteamento e proteção (UTM).
    • Gerenciar redes wireless de grande escala, otimizando desempenho, segurança e resolvendo problemas.
    • Implementar e configurar switches, incluindo VLANs e protocolos avançados de roteamento (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP).

  5. Monitoramento e Diagnóstico:

    • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento de rede e análise de tráfego para diagnóstico proativo e prevenção de interrupções.

  6. Documentação Técnica:

    • Criar, revisar e promover documentações técnicas para uso interno e para clientes, garantindo padronização e clareza.

  7. Desenvolvimento de Equipe:

    • Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos analistas de Nível 1 (N1), promovendo treinamentos e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

  8. Gerenciamento de Crises:

    • Gerenciar crises junto ao time e clientes em casos de incidentes de segurança, indisponibilidades ou problemas críticos relacionados à infraestrutura.

Conhecimentos e Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Experiência em Redes:

    • Configuração, gerenciamento e troubleshooting de redes corporativas (LAN, WAN, WLAN).
    • Implementação e manutenção de switches, roteadores e firewalls.
    • Conhecimento em protocolos de roteamento (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) e VLANs.

  • Conhecimentos Avançados em:

    • Firewalls de múltiplos fabricantes (Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, etc.).
    • Redes wireless de grande escala, com foco em otimização e segurança.
    • Ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de tráfego de rede.

  • Habilidades Adicionais:

    • Capacidade de elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais.
    • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
    • Experiência no atendimento de chamados complexos e em gestão de crises.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em redes e segurança (ex.: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de alta criticidade (NOC/SOC).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de ITIL e boas práticas de gestão de incidentes.

description:
The INNIO Advantage By combining a rich legacy in the power and gas compression space with pioneering technology, INNIO brings our customers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy solutions for today and tomorrow. We are helping to meet today’s energy needs with 64 GW of installed capacity and more than 50,000 of our powerful Jenbacher and Waukesha engines, which can be found in more than 100 countries. And, by harnessing our history of energy industry firsts along with the power of digital innovation, we will continue to deliver for the future.

We are looking for the Regional EHS Operations Specialist to complete our Latam team. This position is based in Brazil, work location ideally Campinas.

Role Description :

The purpose of this role is to support robust Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) practices across LATAM, with a focus on regulatory compliance, risk reduction, and operational excellence for all countries, highlighting Brazil, Peru, and Mexico. This position assists in the development and implementation of EHS programs, contributes to continuous improvement and sustainability initiatives, and ensures alignment with international standards (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001). By providing administrative support, promoting a proactive safety culture, and working closely with management and service teams, this role enhances operational efficiency, supports achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs), and helps safeguard the well-being of all employees and stakeholders.

Responsibilities :

· Oversee Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) compliance and initiatives across LATAM, focusing on Brazil (NR 1–38), Peru (Ley N° 29783), and Mexico (NOM-STPS), in line with ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and ISO 9001 (Quality Management)

· Develop, implement, and update safety, health, and environmental programs, including Electronic Social Security System, Individual Protective Equipment (IPI), Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and required documentation (PPP – Social Security Professional Profile, AST – Work Safety Analysis, APR – Preliminary Risk Analysis, CAT – Work Accident Communication, ASO – Occupational Health Certificate)

· Provide administrative support to management and service areas.

· Conduct risk assessments, hazard identification, and incident investigations, ensuring corrective actions and compliance

· Lead emergency response planning, regulatory monitoring, and maintain permits, licenses, and documentation

· Inform and train personnel on safe practices, deliver Daily Safety Dialogue (DDS), Safety, Health, and Environment (SSMA) lectures, and EHS trainings, including new hire orientation and medical checks

· Manage environmental licensing, Fire Department Inspection Certificate (AVCB), audits, waste disposal, and documentation uploads

· Promote a proactive safety culture, continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma), and Health and Safety Committee participation

· Oversee EHS compliance for contractors and suppliers, and lead sustainability initiatives (waste, energy, water, carbon footprint

· Provide recommendations for operational improvement, support achievement of service key performance indicators (KPIs), and work with the services team to enhance operational efficiency

· Track and report EHS data and KPIs, and support health and wellness programs

· Communicate EHS policies and performance to stakeholders, and support cost optimization and team integration, including language development (English and Spanish)

· Strong collaboration and alignment with EHS Leader at Jenbacher Headquarter

· Perform related other duties as assigned

Qualification Requirements :

· Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, Industrial Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.

· Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, CSP, ISO lead auditor) are considered a plus.

· Experience supporting EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) activities in industrial or service sectors, ideally across LATAM

· Strong knowledge of EHS regulations in LATAM countries, with emphasis on Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, and familiarity with ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards

· Demonstrated skills in risk assessment, incident investigation, and regulatory compliance. Experience delivering EHS training and supporting audits, licensing, and documentation

· Involvement in emergency response, sustainability, and process improvement initiatives

· Ability to work with KPIs and assist management teams

· Ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish

· A Experience collaborating with contractors, suppliers, and cross-functional teams

· Willingness to travel for short periods (incl. internationally), up to 25% or the time, based on needs

Descrição

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia brasileira, fundada em 2013, focada em pesquisa e inteligência de preços. Ajudamos os varejistas a crescerem e evoluírem com a precificação.
Possuímos uma plataforma completa de pricing, do monitoramento da concorrência à precificação inteligente. Acreditamos que o acesso a informações de qualidade beneficia toda a cadeia de valor do varejo, pois permite melhores negociações entre indústria e varejo, e preços mais justos para os consumidores.
São bilhões de dados coletados por ano, transformados em informação por meio de soluções e disponibilizados para clientes e parceiros, proporcionando o monitoramento do mercado, mapeamento de oportunidades, gestão automática e otimização de preços com algoritmos.

O que você fará no seu dia-a-dia:

  • Expandir a base de clientes em potencial da empresa, em especial pelo contato direto com o cliente, mas também através de acompanhamento dos leads gerados;

  • Manter o rastreamento eficiente de todos os leads, bem como as ligações de acompanhamento para garantir que os itens prioritários sejam tocados com rapidez e regularidade, e que todas as contas sejam mantidas em dia;
  • Focar em prospects de alto valor e fazer a transição de leads para novas oportunidades, qualificando-os efetivamente antes de passar para o representante de vendas;
  • Determinar os maiores gaps dos clientes em potencial e apresentar efetivamente a proposta de valor por voz, e-mail ou videoconferência;
  • Compreender como criar valor para os clientes e educar os clientes em potencial de uma forma que os atraia;
  • Fornecer feedbacks eficazes à gerência sobre leads bem-sucedidos e malsucedidos, chamadas e setores de clientes em potencial.

Esse é um desafio para quem tem:

  • Mínimo 2 anos de experiência como SDR/BDR;
  • Conhecimento prévio sobre como usar o CRM (preferencialmente Meetime e Pipe Drive);
  • Experiência em softwares B2B;
  • Pensamento lógico e Capacidade de Resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação e Escuta ativa.

  • Garantir documentação de aplicações e decisões arquiteturais;
  • Assegurar observabilidade das aplicações em produção e atuar na solução de incidentes;
  • Ativamente analisar e melhorar escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança das aplicações;
  • Assumir o ownership de projetos de ponta a ponta;
  • Fortes habilidades de colaboração para remover quaisquer bloqueadores que possa enfrentar;
  • Se manter atualizada com as tendências de desenvolvimento web, frameworks e melhores práticas e recomendar melhorias para aprimorar os processos de desenvolvimento;

Staff (Mínimo 8 anos de experiência)

  • Além de todos os itens anteriores:
  • Influenciar na desambiguação de evoluções arquiteturais e decisões técnicas;
  • Permanecer ativo com a codificação, contribuindo diretamente enquanto orienta e ajuda a desenvolver membros menos experientes;
  • Promover uma cultura de time inclusiva e orientada por feedback que incentive o aprendizado e a melhoria contínuos;
  • Ter capacidade de equilibrar e priorizar demandas concorrentes;
  • Participar ativamente do processo seletivo.

O que você precisa para virar a chave?

  • Histórico sólido em desenvolvimento web, com foco em frontend.
  • System design e code design patterns;
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativos web responsivos e de alta qualidade;
  • Princípios de SEO;
  • Arquitetura de Microfrontend;
  • Fundamentos de navegadores, estratégias de renderização, design de API e desenvolvimento de BFF;
  • Observabilidade de sistemas;
  • Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Técnicas de teste automatizado de software;
  • Componentes reutilizáveis e modulares que promovem a reutilização, a manutenibilidade e a escalabilidade do código;
  • Metodologias ágeis e ter mindset de start-up;
  • Tomada de decisões usando métricas e dados;

Description
Are you data driven and like identifying actionable insights that translate into growth initiatives that drive the business? Excel in identifying and communicating mutually beneficial customer and partner propositions and benefits? A creative marketer that can think big and make it happen? Then the Partner Growth Marketing team at Amazon could be the perfect fit for you, where we build dynamic future for Amazon subscriptions across the globe.
The Partner Growth Marketing team (Fuse) within Amazon’s Corporate Business Development group enables partners across multiple verticals to resell our subscription services including Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited, Kindle Unlimited, and more. You will work with Amazon partners across Brasil and have a direct impact on end customers, seeking to maximize acquisition and customer retention with these partners across existing and new customer segments and offers. Our partners leverage Amazon’s services to drive differentiated offerings and streamlined access for their customers across the globe. We need experienced growth marketing leaders to help us drive great results and grow our established subscription member bases, while help us launch new ones. The team is seeking a talented, self-directed and high energy growth marketing innovator to help drive our efforts in Brasil, including successful partner launches and strong customer adoption, engagement, and retention. Our ideal candidate will have demonstrated an ability to build successful launch and growth campaigns, by diving deep into the insights around customer data including video streaming and online shopping usage trends, analyzing and reducing churn, while managing the customer lifecycle all the way through the funnel. The candidate must be able to work collaboratively and independently, building trust across internal teams as well as external partners. The focus will be on building, measuring and optimizing successful, results-oriented marketing programs in a fast-paced environment, often with speedy timelines, across new partner launches and on-going campaigns focused on growth marketing efforts that acquire new customers to our subscription services. This person must also have experience in creating centralized programs that can be leveraged on a global scale, both directly and by others. Above all, this person must have a passion for understanding what drives a great consumer experience (CX) across both the digital and physical space. The candidate should possess a builder/start-up mentality and work well in ambiguous situations.
Key job responsibilities
The role will be held accountable to deliver on team and partner goals that specifically drive new customers and sustained engagement.
As a Senior Partner Growth Manager, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver against an annual forecast of Prime and Prime Video subscriptions driven by partners.
  • Collaborating internally and working across cross-functional teams to deliver best in class campaign opportunities and assets for our partners across Prime, Prime Video, and more.
  • Working closely with partners to understand their customers, how their business operates, their goals and their approach to marketing and content, and owning the end-to-end delivery of all partner launches and subsequent growth marketing efforts to drive signups to our subscription services post-launch.
  • Leading, implementing and launching partner campaign with the North Star to deliver best-in-class creative excellence that represents both Prime/Prime Video brand and Fuse offer awareness through a partner.
  • Diving deep into the data to understand insights and learnings, that in turn drive strategy. Lead performance for partners in your region. Share market intelligence and insights with stakeholders and other teammates.
  • Manage end-to-end ideation, execution, and analysis/reporting on campaigns including work-back-schedules, stakeholder approvals, asset/content set-up, and subsequent launch.
  • Develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational efficiency of the team and acquisition impact.
  • Creating ongoing marketing programs and propositions for key partners to market our services, and drive customer engagement and retention.
  • Continually optimizing partnerships from launch through to ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in comms, and share of voice (SOV).
  • Diving deep on the customer journey to deliver a great experience and great results.
  • Leading, influencing, and executing integrated go-to-market plans with multiple partners in different business verticals and across relevant internal teams.
  • Building ongoing communication channels with and through partners.
  • Partnering with Business Development leads on the sell-in of new partnerships with pitches, proposals, and B2B communications that bring Amazon’s services and content to life.
  • Experimenting with new ways to drive partnership success.
  • Functioning at a global level, sharing best practices, and scaling programs or campaigns that benefit North America, Latin America, and other regions.

  • +8 years of marketing experience in B2B2C partner-focused growth marketing across different industries such as: mobile, telecommunications, retail, financial institutions, film, media, music, television or gaming.
  • Ability to view partners as customers, focusing on their needs and goals, and driving great programs for customers that drive great results for partners.
  • Ability to create innovative new programs around entertainment and shopping seasonalities that generate results.
  • Relentless focus on data to make decisions and drive results, able to identify actionable learnings that explain/drive results.
  • Ability to analyze and dive deep on end-to-end CX flows to improve customer experience.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with senior management both internally and externally.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-partner relationships/projects.
  • Strong bias for action and ownership, and ability to work independently toward stated goals with minimal oversight.
  • A passion for managing details to optimize programs, tools, and creatives. Attention to details to continuously raise the bar.
  • Demonstrated track record in developing, implementing and optimizing multi-channel, integrated marketing campaigns that focus on growth/performance marketing.
  • Excellent written communications and business case writing skills.

  • High sense of ownership.

title: Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)
description:
Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Join to apply for the Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Join to apply for the Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical .
We are building documentation capacity at scale. We have dozens of positions available , for products and teams across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff.
All applications and candidates are handled through this one entry-point. We'll be able to discuss seniority levels, suitable teams and more later in the process, to help place you in the most suitable role for you.
The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
The role entails

  • Create, maintain and improve software documentation
  • Work with engineering team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of the product, as an expert user of the product, who has important opinions about its function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team
What we are looking for in you
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation
  • Has a record of community engagement, in open-source software, documentation, research or other disciplines
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open-source software and its communities
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity, and is fascinated by software technology and its challenges
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight and enthusiasm
  • Has experience of software development contexts; is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, application deployment, system operations, and infrastructure management, Git, documentation markup languages
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events
Nice-to-have skills
  • Deep technical domain knowledge
  • Open-source community leadership and management
  • User-experience, interaction or visual design
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.

Ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto.

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Solutions Architect for Automotive to help our partners (companies like Mercedes, Ford, GM, Elektrobit, Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) and prospects understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to embedded. And we continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
Beyond an expected Automotive expertise, this career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Liaise with other Canonical's experts (mastering the Cloud, Kubernetes, Security or Safety, etc) to aggregate our collective knowledge into comprehensive solutions for our prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux, including demos and PoCs
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies applied to Automotive, if you want to play an active role in building Software Defined Vehicles, if you are curious with a will to learn how to leverage and adapt Cloud technologies to the embedded world, you will love working at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience - Yocto or RTOS
  • Fluency in Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Relevant experience in the Automotive industry
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
Additional skills that you might also bring (but not mandatory)
  • Experience with ISO26262 and/or ISO21434
  • Experience with customer engagements
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
O Arquiteto de Software III é responsável por projetar e definir a arquitetura de soluções complexas, garantindo a escalabilidade, segurança, e performance das aplicações. Este profissional lidera as decisões técnicas, define padrões de desenvolvimento e atua como referência técnica para as equipes de engenharia, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com stakeholders de tecnologia e negócios.
Ele também é responsável por assegurar que a arquitetura dos sistemas esteja alinhada com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, além de promover inovação tecnológica.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Desenho e Definição da Arquitetura de Software III:

  • Projetar e definir arquiteturas de software complexas, focando em escalabilidade, performance e alta disponibilidade.
  • Elaborar diagramas arquitetônicos e padrões de design, assegurando que as soluções sejam modulares, eficientes e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir a integração entre microsserviços, APIs, banco de dados e sistemas externos, promovendo uma arquitetura robusta e segura.
  • Padrões e Melhores Práticas de Desenvolvimento:
  • Estabelecer e promover padrões de design (Design Patterns) e práticas de desenvolvimento orientadas a objetos, DDD (Domain-Driven Design) e TDD (Test-Driven Development).
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de revisões periódicas, auditorias e aplicação de boas práticas.
  • Definir as melhores abordagens para o uso de frameworks, linguagens e bibliotecas adequadas ao projeto.
Padrões e Melhores Práticas de Desenvolvimento:
  • Estabelecer e promover padrões de design (Design Patterns) e práticas de desenvolvimento orientadas a objetos, DDD (Domain-Driven Design) e TDD (Test-Driven Development).
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de revisões periódicas, auditorias e aplicação de boas práticas.
  • Definir as melhores abordagens para o uso de frameworks, linguagens e bibliotecas adequadas ao projeto.
Escalabilidade e Performance:
  • Avaliar e implementar soluções para otimizar a performance dos sistemas, garantindo o uso eficiente de recursos computacionais.
  • Garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis tanto vertical quanto horizontalmente, usando técnicas como caching, load balancing, sharding e clustering.
  • Implementar estratégias para reduzir latência e aumentar a resiliência dos sistemas.
Segurança e Conformidade:
  • Definir e implementar políticas de segurança que protejam os dados e sistemas contra ameaças externas e internas.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de segurança para realizar auditorias de conformidade, proteger APIs e garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações (ex.: LGPD, GDPR).
  • Aplicar técnicas de criptografia e autenticação segura, garantindo a integridade dos dados sensíveis.
Inovação e Pesquisa Tecnológica:
  • Explorar e adotar novas tecnologias e frameworks que possam melhorar a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Realizar POCs (Proof of Concept) para validar a adoção de novas tecnologias no contexto da arquitetura atual da empresa.
  • Estabelecer uma visão de longo prazo para a evolução dos sistemas, promovendo inovações tecnológicas alinhadas com as tendências do mercado.
Mentoria e Liderança Técnica:
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e mentoria contínua para desenvolvedores, garantindo que todos sigam as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir sessões de treinamento técnico sobre arquitetura de software e inovações tecnológicas.

description:
Quem somos?

O Insper é uma instituição sem fins lucrativos com propósitos de gerar conhecimento com base em dados que apoie tomada de decisão capaz de transformar a sociedade, além de formar pessoas que façam a diferença nos negócios e para o país. A paixão por educar é o que nos move e buscamos profissionais que acreditem em nossas causas, entendendo que engajamento, energia, trabalho em equipe e transparência são essenciais para realizarmos nossa missão!

Estamos em constante crescimento e priorizamos a inovação em nossos cursos e áreas de atuação. Nosso principal objetivo é formar cidadãos que transformem positivamente a sociedade.

Que tal fazer parte da construção de um ambiente com mais diversidade? Acreditamos que cor, gênero, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, religião e origem não definem competências. O Insper é para todas e todos.

Missão do cargo

Atuar de forma estratégica no planejamento e na execução de ações de comunicação que reforcem o posicionamento institucional do Insper, contribuindo para a reputação da marca e a consolidação da imagem da instituição como referência em educação, inovação e transformação social. Responsável por desenvolver conteúdos, campanhas e experiências alinhadas à identidade institucional, colaborando com áreas internas, ao lado de uma analista, e apoiando a gerente na condução dos projetos do núcleo.

Definir e acompanhar o orçamento da área, buscando respeitar os valores previamente orçados e as demais regras orçamentárias do Insper, além de identificar oportunidades de melhor aproveitamento dos recursos disponíveis. Gestão anual de cerca de R$ 1 milhão, excluindo despesas com pessoal.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão da marca e comunicação institucional
  • Contribuir para a governança da marca institucional, promovendo consistência nas mensagens, no tom de voz e na identidade visual em todos os pontos de contato.
  • Desenvolver e aplicar materiais de merchandising institucional, assegurando coerência com os atributos da marca e com o posicionamento estratégico da instituição.
  • Apoiar transversalmente projetos liderados por outras áreas, garantindo alinhamento com a identidade institucional e com a estratégia de comunicação.
  • Colaborar com o escritório de advocacia responsável pela proteção legal da marca, fortalecendo o capital simbólico da instituição.
  • Planejar e executar campanhas integradas de awareness, com foco em visibilidade institucional, datas estratégicas, causas e posicionamentos.
  • Coordenar o impulsionamento de conteúdos institucionais nos canais próprios e pagos, ampliando o alcance das mensagens-chave.
  • Apoiar eventos institucionais no desenvolvimento de identidade visual, narrativa e presença da marca.
  • Atuar na leitura, interpretação e aplicação de dados de reputação (como os extraídos de ferramentas como Cortex e Stilling), apoiando decisões estratégicas baseadas em evidências.
  • Mapear e coordenar a participação do Insper em premiações, rankings e reconhecimentos institucionais, avaliando oportunidades e negociando ações como branded content.
  • Apoiar o relacionamento institucional com parceiros estratégicos e iniciativas de reconhecimento de marca.
  • Articular-se com os núcleos internos da área de comunicação (atendimento, imprensa, audiovisual, redes sociais, eventos e design) assegurando fluidez, integração e sinergia nas entregas.
  • Estabelecer relacionamento próximo com áreas-chave como Compras, Suprimentos, Coordenações Acadêmicas e de Pesquisa, Professores e Pesquisadores, promovendo iniciativas alinhadas aos valores e à reputação institucional.
  • Apoio à liderança e acompanhamento de equipe
  • Apoiar a gerente na condução dos projetos do núcleo de marketing institucional, contribuindo com visão estratégica, organização e capacidade de articulação.
  • Acompanhar e orientar as entregas da analista do time, assegurando qualidade, coerência narrativa e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da comunicação institucional.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Comunicação Social, Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado desejável, preferencialmente em instituições de excelência.
  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em comunicação institucional e marketing, com foco em campanhas, reputação de marca e relacionamento com públicos estratégicos.

  • Familiaridade com indicadores de desempenho, métricas de reputação e ferramentas de monitoramento.

  • Perfil analítico, colaborativo e propositivo. Excelente organização, gestão do tempo e autonomia em ambientes dinâmicos. Capacidade de liderar projetos e gerir conflitos com foco em soluções.

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Description

Esta é uma vaga que tem o intuito de coletar talentos para posições futuras.

A Amazon Brasil valoriza a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas posições de trabalho, e por isso atuamos com intencionalidade para que nosso ambiente interno reflita a pluralidade dos mercados em que atuamos e clientes que atendemos. No Brasil, estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de áreas e cargos diferentes, pois entendemos que essa agenda precisa de diferentes perspectivas e vivências múltiplas. Nossa liderança é engajada e entende cada dia mais o seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com o objetivo de sermos "a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo". Sabemos da nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança e somos conscientes de que "Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades". Nossos grupos de afinidade são formados por pessoas voluntárias de diferentes unidades de negócio e são parte ativa na definição das estratégias de DEI. Além disso, atuam como embaixadores dessa agenda e vão te apoiar desde o Day 1. Lembre-se, "it´s always Day 1". Os grupos estão organizados nas seguintes frentes: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.

Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) é um serviço que visa ajudar marcas e parceiros estratégicos a se desenvolverem de maneira sustentável com a Amazon. AVS ajuda os parceiros na Amazon a crescer de maneira sustentável, além de aumentar a disponibilidade e a descoberta de seus produtos. A Equipe de Especialistas Supply Chain é especializada em ajudar parceiros com desafios operacionais, a alinhar melhor seus processos logísticos com a Amazon, analisar problemas de cadeia de suprimentos e desenvolver soluções sustentáveis para evitar perdas financeiras e proporcionar a melhor experiência para nossos clientes. Nesta posição, você reportará à liderança de gestão de operações de categoria e trabalhará para construir a estratégia de Supply Chain de contas chave. Você será responsável por liderar o planejamento de previsão de estoque, execução de compras e melhoria operacional de projetos, atuando como ponto de contato chave para gestão de estoque para um segmento de fornecedores. Você irá trabalhar na identificação de oportunidades de simplificar e automatizar tarefas, garantindo que sistemas e processos de inventário atendam às necessidades do negócio, além de implementar controles sobre estes. A pessoa ideal terá energia para lidar com um ambiente em que atividades táticas e estratégicas acontecerão paralelamente.

Nesta posição, você irá gerenciar fornecedores de média a alta complexidade, trabalhando com orientação limitada para entregar o serviço. Você também será responsável por projetos de pequeno a médio impacto, atingindo especialistas de Supply Chain AVS em sua categoria.

Key job responsibilities

  • Análise da operação de supply chain utilizando dados e identificando as causas dos problemas operacionais (giro de estoque, lead time, reabastecimento, taxa de confirmação, forecast) - Definição de planos de ação conjunta com os parceiros para eliminar defeitos de Supply Chain e fazer revisões regulares de progresso com fornecedores para criar resultados sustentáveis de longo prazo;
  • Cooperar e construir um relacionamento de confiança em todas as funções e níveis de trabalho dentro da organização do parceiro (por exemplo, gerente de contas chave, gerente de Supply Chain, gerente de atendimento ao cliente), bem como na Amazon (Vendor Managers - gerentes comerciais, especialistas de contas chave, InStock Managers - gerentes de Supply Chain, gerentes de produto/programa, equipes de operações);
  • Preparação de revisões regulares de progresso para implementar soluções sustentáveis e resultados de longo prazo;
  • Organização e gestão de projetos com fornecedores sobre melhoria contínua/Kaizens;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos internos para desenvolver ainda mais o programa AVS (por exemplo, planejamento de recursos, comunicação interna e externa, criação de mecanismos para soluções de problemas de toda a população de fornecedores, automação de relatórios etc.)

Basic Qualifications

  • Bacharel/Licenciatura (engenharia, administração ou áreas relacionadas à operações/cadeia de suprimento/logística);
  • Habilidade analítica, afinidade com números e habilidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Capacidade de auto-organização, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo;
  • Experiência em gestão de produto/categoria, gestão da cadeia de suprimentos, planejamento de negócios ou consultoria;
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal de básica a intermediária em Inglês ou disponibilidade para aprender no trabalho com meios providos pela Amazon

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experiência com SQL;
  • Experiência com painéis de dados (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense);
  • Experiência com Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen.

Join to apply for the Lead HR Generalist - Americas role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region
The role entails

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
  • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team
  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Paid Media Specialist

Paid Media Specialist
 Chili Digital is a performance-driven digital marketing agency operating across Latin America.
We specialize in SEO, paid media, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and data-driven marketing strategies that maximize return on investment. Our approach is rooted in technical expertise and analytics, ensuring brands achieve sustainable growth through measurable results.
We are committed to fostering homegrown talent and helping the best companies in our region compete on a global scale while supporting international brands in thriving across Latin America.
Why Join Us?
Joining Chili Digital is an exciting opportunity if you're looking for:

  • Cutting-Edge Campaigns: Work on diverse, high-impact performance campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Data-Driven Success: Your strategic insights will directly contribute to our clients' ROI and ROAS, impacting real business outcomes.
  • Dynamic Environment: Collaborate with experts in SEO, content, and creative teams while continuously learning in a fast-paced agency setting.
  • Career Growth: We invest in your professional development, offering opportunities to refine your skills and take on more strategic responsibilities.

About The Role
The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for managing and optimizing omnichannel performance campaigns. This role requires a deep understanding of media channels including Google, Meta, TikTok, Retail Media, and a familiarity with programmatic advertising. You will oversee the complete campaign lifecycle from client onboarding and media planning to execution, A/B testing, and performance reporting, ensuring clear demonstration of ROI/ROAS. Strong organizational skills and proficiency in managing tasks through our CRM SENTR are essential. Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required as you will execute campaigns in both languages.
In Detail:
Campaign Strategy & Lifecycle Management
  • Client Onboarding: Collaborate with clients to understand their business goals and align paid media strategies accordingly.
  • Media Planning: Develop detailed media plans that define target audiences, budgets, channels, and key performance indicators.
  • Campaign Execution: Launch and manage campaigns across multiple platforms, ensuring optimal allocation of resources for maximum performance.
  • A/B Testing: Plan and execute A/B tests across platforms to determine optimal creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages.
  • Optimization & Reporting: Continuously monitor performance, implement learnings from A/B tests, and generate comprehensive reports to demonstrate ROI/ROAS.

Channel Expertise
  • Google & Meta: Deep knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms to drive effective search, display, and social media campaigns.
  • Emerging Channels: Experience with TikTok and Retail Media, ensuring innovative strategies across less traditional channels.
  • Programmatic Advertising: Familiarity with programmatic buying to enhance targeting and scalability is an added advantage.

Organizational Excellence
  • Task Management: Utilize our CRM SENTR to manage campaign tasks, timelines, A/B test tracking, and client communications efficiently.
  • Bilingual Execution: Develop and execute campaigns in both Portuguese and English, ensuring culturally relevant messaging and market compliance.

Performance Measurement
  • ROI/ROAS Focus: Report directly on the return on investment (ROI) and return on ad spend (ROAS), using data-driven insights to optimize performance.
  • Analytics & Insights: Leverage analytics tools and performance data to recommend strategies, incorporating learnings from A/B testing for better campaign outcomes.

Requirements:
  • 3+ years of experience in managing paid media campaigns, ideally within a digital marketing agency.
  • Proven track record of driving performance campaigns with clear ROI/ROAS outcomes.
  • Strong expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms, with working experience on TikTok, Retail Media, and programmatic channels.
  • Experience managing the complete campaign lifecycle—from client onboarding and media planning to execution, A/B testing, and performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated success in setting up and interpreting A/B tests to improve performance.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and proficiency with CRM systems, specifically SENTR.
  • Fluent in both Spanish and English, with excellent communication and reporting skills in both languages.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment with a proactive and collaborative approach.

Benefits:
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Hybrid work model – two days of remote work per week.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge campaigns with international clients across LATAM, US, and Europe.
  • Access to advanced tools and training in paid media strategies.
  • Participating in our selection process is completely free of charge. We never request payments or require any courses as a condition to apply.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical
As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.
You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.
You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.
We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.
Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

  • Interact with a vibrant community

  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve

  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)

  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
